how: Each question was answered by a separate fresh Claude Code subagent (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06) that saw only the system prompt and that one question; no API call, no gold answers, no tools beyond reading its prompt file. Replies are recorded verbatim.

replies.2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
replies.3: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'
replies.4: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'
replies.6: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry
replies.7: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1
replies.8: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType LEFT JOIN Track ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name
replies.10: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'
replies.11: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Year
replies.12: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack pt WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId)
replies.13: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
replies.14: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1
replies.15: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Album.ArtistId) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'
replies.16: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
replies.17: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
replies.18: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 20
replies.19: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(Composer) = ''
replies.20: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UnitPrice = 0.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS PercentagePricedAt099 FROM Track
